[Image: A circle on a Cartesian coordinate plane]

What is the equation of the circle shown above?
figure_description: A Cartesian coordinate plane with a grid of 1-unit squares. The horizontal x-axis has tick marks and numbers at -4, -2, 2, 4, and 6, with the origin labeled O. The vertical y-axis has tick marks and numbers at -6, -4, -2, 2, and 4. Both axes have arrows at both ends. A circle is drawn on the grid with its center at (3, -2) and a radius of 4 units. Its topmost point is at (3, 2), bottommost point at (3, -6), leftmost point at (-1, -2), and rightmost point at (7, -2). The circle intersects the x-axis between -1 and 0 and between 6 and 7, and intersects the y-axis between 0 and 1 and between -5 and -4.
